mappings.visualRationale: Visibly shows a bright azure, frothing funnel-shaped maelstrom vortex swirling dynamically down into a deep oceanic abyss, directly matching Kawitzek reshaping and swirling water into a powerful whirlpool.
Visibly shows a disorienting lavender and violet spiral funnel cloud swirling inward against a radiating background, capturing the dizzying hypnotic trance that stuns a target helplessly.

Visibly shows an outstretched open hand and fingertips emitting a dark violet and magenta necrotic aura with glowing contact energy, capturing a close-range touch attack delivering lethal unholy damage.
